image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) viewed from a high-angle dorsal perspective, resting on a bed of bright green moss. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow spots and bands. Its limbs are splayed out, showing short digits. The tail is visible extending to the left. The lighting highlights the moist texture of the skin.
